  "canonical_python_code": "import numpy as np
from scipy.sparse import diags, eye, kron
from scipy.sparse.linalg import splu


def calibrate_affine_banks(raw_observations: np.ndarray, observation_banks: np.ndarray,
                           reference_levels: np.ndarray, sweep_readouts: np.ndarray,
                           sweep_banks: np.ndarray, *, prior: np.ndarray | None = None,
                           triple_rtol: float = 1e-6) -> np.ndarray:
    '''Invert raw = gain * reference + offset independently for each bank.

    Pass finite 1-D arrays with nonnegative integer bank IDs. Prior rows
    contain (positive gain, offset), defaulting to (1, 0). Unidentified gains
    stay at the prior; with current sweeps the fallback offset is their median
    residual. No ridge is used on accepted slopes. For triples, gate on the
    maximum least-squares residual divided by the readout span. For four or
    more sweeps, select a positive median-residual line, screen at 4.5 robust
    scales, then refit the retained sweeps. This assumes a clean majority.
    '''
    raw = np.asarray(raw_observations, dtype=float)
    banks, sweep_ids = np.asarray(observation_banks), np.asarray(sweep_banks)
    refs, reads = np.asarray(reference_levels, float), np.asarray(sweep_readouts, float)
    priors = None if prior is None else np.asarray(prior, float)
    corrected = np.empty_like(raw)
    for bank in np.unique(banks):
        rows, sweeps = banks == bank, sweep_ids == bank
        x, y = refs[sweeps], reads[sweeps]
        gain, offset = (1.0, 0.0) if priors is None else priors[bank]
        if not np.isfinite(gain) or gain <= 0:
            raise ValueError('Prior gains must be finite and positive')
        if x.size:
            offset = float(np.median(y - gain * x))
            xspan, yspan = np.ptp(x), np.ptp(y)
            if xspan > 0 and yspan > 0:
                u = (x - np.median(x)) / xspan
                v = (y - np.median(y)) / yspan
                keep = np.ones(x.size, dtype=bool)
                if x.size >= 4:
                    i, j = np.triu_indices(x.size, 1)
                    du = u[j] - u[i]
                    distinct = np.abs(du) > 1e-12
                    slopes = (v[j[distinct]] - v[i[distinct]]) / du[distinct]
                    slopes = slopes[slopes > 0]
                    if slopes.size:
                        residual = v - slopes[:, None] * u
                        err = np.abs(residual - np.median(residual, axis=1)[:, None])
                        med = np.median(err, axis=1)
                        best = int(np.argmin(med))
                        keep = err[best] <= 4.5 * max(1.4826 * med[best], 1e-12)
                    else:
                        keep[:] = False
                if np.count_nonzero(keep) >= 2 and np.ptp(u[keep]) > 1e-12:
                    a = u[keep] - u[keep].mean()
                    b = v[keep] - v[keep].mean()
                    slope = float((a @ b) / (a @ a))
                    misfit = np.max(np.abs(b - slope * a))
                    if slope > 0 and (x.size != 3 or misfit <= triple_rtol):
                        gain = slope * yspan / xspan
                        offset = float(y[keep].mean() - gain * x[keep].mean())
        corrected[rows] = (raw[rows] - offset) / gain
    return corrected


def separable_transport_design(lengths: tuple[float, float],
                               diffusivities: tuple[np.ndarray, np.ndarray],
                               velocities: tuple[np.ndarray, np.ndarray],
                               robin: tuple[float, float],
                               baseline_reactions: tuple[np.ndarray, np.ndarray],
                               reaction_field: np.ndarray, source_modes: np.ndarray,
                               shifts: np.ndarray, sensor_indices: np.ndarray, *,
                               separability_rtol: float = 1e-6) -> tuple[np.ndarray, np.ndarray]:
    '''Solve shifted steady transport on a uniform cell-centered rectangle.

    Diffusivities have units length²/time; velocity and Robin transfer have
    units length/time. Robin transfer is equal at both ends of each axis;
    upwind advection uses zero exterior inflow values. Baselines, added
    reaction and shifts are rates. Source modes are (M,nx,ny). Replace the
    added field by its additive projection only within the relative Frobenius
    tolerance. There is no forward regularization; shifted operators must
    be invertible. Return shift-first sensor rows and last-shift modes
    (nx,ny,M). Sensor cells are sampled in the supplied order.
    '''
    reaction = np.asarray(reaction_field, float)
    modes, mu = np.asarray(source_modes, float), np.asarray(shifts, float)
    nx, ny = reaction.shape
    if min(nx, ny) < 1 or modes.ndim != 3 or modes.shape[1:] != reaction.shape or mu.ndim != 1 or not mu.size:
        raise ValueError('Supply a nonempty rectangle, grid-shaped modes, and shifts')
    vx = reaction.mean(axis=1)
    vy = reaction.mean(axis=0) - reaction.mean()
    defect = reaction - (vx[:, None] + vy[None, :])
    if np.linalg.norm(defect) > separability_rtol * np.linalg.norm(reaction):
        raise ValueError('Added reaction exceeds the relative separability tolerance')
    operators = []
    for axis, (n, extra) in enumerate(((nx, vx), (ny, vy))):
        length = lengths[axis]
        k = np.asarray(diffusivities[axis], float)
        v = np.asarray(velocities[axis], float)
        base = np.asarray(baseline_reactions[axis], float)
        transfer = robin[axis]
        if k.shape != (n,) or v.shape != (n,) or base.shape != (n,):
            raise ValueError('Axis coefficients must be cellwise')
        if length <= 0 or np.any(k <= 0) or transfer < 0:
            raise ValueError('Require positive lengths and diffusion, nonnegative Robin transfer')
        h = 1.0 / n
        k, v, transfer = (k / length) / length, v / length, transfer / length
        p, m = np.maximum(v, 0) / h, np.maximum(-v, 0) / h
        q = 2 * k[:-1] * k[1:] / ((k[:-1] + k[1:]) * h**2)
        main = base + extra + p + m
        main[:-1] += q
        main[1:] += q
        ends = np.array([0, n - 1])
        np.add.at(main, ends, transfer * k[ends] / (h * (transfer * h / 2 + k[ends])))
        bands = ((main,), (0,)) if n == 1 else ((-q - p[1:], main, -q - m[:-1]), (-1, 0, 1))
        operators.append(diags(*bands, format='csc'))
    ax, by = operators
    op = (kron(ax, eye(ny)) + kron(eye(nx), by)).tocsc()
    identity = eye(nx * ny, format='csc')
    rhs = modes.reshape(modes.shape[0], nx * ny).T
    i, j = np.asarray(sensor_indices).T
    rows = []
    for shift in mu:
        field = splu(op + shift * identity).solve(rhs).reshape(nx, ny, modes.shape[0])
        rows.append(field[i, j])
    return np.concatenate(rows, axis=0), field


def fit_box_simplex(design: np.ndarray, observations: np.ndarray, nuisance: np.ndarray, *,
                    cap: float, budget: float, source_ridge: float,
                    nuisance_ridge: float = 0.0) -> tuple[np.ndarray, dict[str, float | np.ndarray]]:
    '''Minimize half the squared direct ridge-fit residual plus source ridge.

    Apply the same residual operator to the design and observations; this is
    not the joint penalized least-squares optimum when nuisance_ridge > 0.
    Nuisance ridge defaults to zero (orthogonal projection); pass (N,0) for
    no nuisance. Source ridge is strictly positive. Both ridges scale as
    squared column norms of their respective matrices. Enforce 0 <= w <= cap
    and sum(w) = budget. Report a KKT certificate with stationarity convention
    g - nu_sum - lam_lower + lam_upper = 0 and a tangent dual lower bound.
    The active-set gradient tolerance is 1e-12 in normalized coordinates.
    '''
    D, y, Z = np.asarray(design, float), np.asarray(observations, float), np.asarray(nuisance, float)
    if D.ndim != 2 or y.shape != (D.shape[0],) or Z.ndim != 2 or Z.shape[0] != D.shape[0]:
        raise ValueError('Design, observations and nuisance must share rows')
    n = D.shape[1]
    if n == 0 or cap <= 0 or not 0 <= budget <= n * cap:
        raise ValueError('Infeasible box-simplex')
    if source_ridge <= 0 or nuisance_ridge < 0:
        raise ValueError('Require positive source ridge and nonnegative nuisance ridge')
    Y = np.column_stack((D, y))
    if Z.shape[1] and nuisance_ridge == 0:
        Y -= Z @ np.linalg.lstsq(Z, Y, rcond=None)[0]
    elif Z.shape[1]:
        U, s, _ = np.linalg.svd(Z, full_matrices=False)
        Y -= U @ ((s**2 / (s**2 + nuisance_ridge))[:, None] * (U.T @ Y))
    S, r = Y[:, :-1], Y[:, -1]
    A = cap * S
    H = A.T @ A + source_ridge * cap**2 * np.eye(n)
    c = -(A.T @ r)
    scale = max(np.max(np.abs(H)), np.max(np.abs(c)))
    H, c = H / scale, c / scale
    if budget == 0:
        x, nu = np.zeros(n), float(c.min())
    elif budget == n * cap:
        x = np.ones(n)
        nu = float(np.max(H @ x + c))
    else:
        x = np.full(n, budget / (n * cap))
        state = np.zeros(n, dtype=int)
        for _ in range(100 * n):
            g = H @ x + c
            free = np.flatnonzero(state == 0)
            if not free.size:
                lo = int(np.argmin(np.where(state < 0, g, np.inf)))
                hi = int(np.argmax(np.where(state > 0, g, -np.inf)))
                if g[hi] <= g[lo] + 1e-12:
                    nu = float((g[lo] + g[hi]) / 2)
                    break
                state[[lo, hi]] = 0
                continue
            a, b = np.linalg.solve(H[np.ix_(free, free)],
                                   np.column_stack((g[free], np.ones(free.size)))).T
            nu = float(a.sum() / b.sum())
            step = nu * b - a
            alpha = np.full(free.size, np.inf)
            np.divide(1 - x[free], step, out=alpha, where=step > 1e-14)
            np.divide(-x[free], step, out=alpha, where=step < -1e-14)
            hit = int(alpha.argmin())
            if alpha[hit] < 1:
                x[free] += max(0.0, alpha[hit]) * step
                state[free[hit]] = 1 if step[hit] > 0 else -1
                x[free[hit]] = float(state[free[hit]] > 0)
                continue
            x[free] += step
            violation = state * (H @ x + c - nu)
            release = int(violation.argmax())
            if violation[release] <= 1e-12:
                break
            state[release] = 0
        else:
            raise RuntimeError('Box-simplex active set did not converge')
    w = cap * np.clip(x, 0, 1)
    nu_sum = float(nu * scale / cap)
    residual = S @ w - r
    g = S.T @ residual + source_ridge * w
    lower = np.maximum(g - nu_sum, 0)
    upper = np.maximum(nu_sum - g, 0)
    primal = float(0.5 * (residual @ residual + source_ridge * (w @ w)))
    bound = primal + nu_sum * (budget - w.sum()) - lower @ w - upper @ (cap - w)
    return w, {'weights': w.copy(), 'nu_sum': nu_sum, 'lam_lower': lower,
               'lam_upper': upper, 'primal_objective': primal, 'dual_lower_bound': float(bound)}
",
  "synthetic_unit_test_code": "import numpy as np


def run_self_test():
    lengths = (2., 4.)
    k = (np.array([1., 3.]), np.array([2., 6.]))
    v = (np.array([-.4, .2]), np.array([.6, .2]))
    robin = (.5, .4)
    base = (np.array([.2, .6]), np.array([.4, .1]))
    reaction = np.array([.1, .3])[:, None] + np.array([-.05, .05])
    shifts = np.array([.2, .8])
    sensors = np.array([[1, 1], [0, 0], [1, 0], [0, 1]])
    # Independent two-cell stencils: heterogeneous diffusion, upwind, and Robin.
    ax = np.array([[1.5 + .4 + .4 + .2 + .1, -1.9],
                   [-1.7, 1.5 + .2 + 6/13 + .6 + .3]])
    by = np.array([[.75 + .3 + 1/6 + .4 - .05, -.75],
                   [-.85, .75 + .1 + .1875 + .1 + .05]])
    truth = np.array([[[1., 0., 0.], [0., 2., 0.]],
                      [[0., 0., 3.], [1., -1., .5]]])
    modes = np.stack([ax @ u + u @ by.T + shifts[-1] * u for u in truth.transpose(2, 0, 1)])
    D, terminal = separable_transport_design(lengths, k, v, robin, base, reaction, modes, shifts, sensors)
    np.testing.assert_allclose(terminal, truth, atol=2e-12)
    op = np.kron(ax, np.eye(2)) + np.kron(np.eye(2), by)
    first = np.linalg.solve(op + shifts[0] * np.eye(4), modes.reshape(3, 4).T).reshape(2, 2, 3)
    i, j = sensors.T
    np.testing.assert_allclose(D, np.vstack((first[i, j], truth[i, j])), atol=2e-12)
    try:
        separable_transport_design(lengths, k, v, robin, base,
                                   reaction + .01*np.eye(2), modes, shifts, sensors)
    except ValueError:
        pass
    else:
        raise AssertionError('Nonseparable reaction passed the routing gate')

    # Length ×0.01 and rate ×2 leave the dimensionless operator and fields unchanged.
    # Sensor cells are not reciprocal links: changing their order only permutes rows.
    ell, rate = .01, 2.
    perm = np.array([2, 0, 3, 1])
    row_perm = np.r_[perm, len(sensors) + perm]
    D2, terminal2 = separable_transport_design(
        tuple(ell*a for a in lengths), tuple(ell**2*rate*a for a in k),
        tuple(ell*rate*a for a in v), tuple(ell*rate*a for a in robin),
        tuple(rate*a for a in base), rate*reaction, rate*modes, rate*shifts, sensors[perm])
    np.testing.assert_allclose(D2, D[row_perm], atol=2e-12)
    np.testing.assert_allclose(terminal2, terminal, atol=2e-12)

    # Manufacture the KKT gradient for a solution with both bounds active.
    w_true, g_true = np.array([0., .4, .6]), np.array([.3, .1, -.2])
    ridge = .2
    Z = np.zeros((len(D), 1)); Z[0, 0] = 1.
    # Direct residualization with nuisance ridge 1 multiplies the first row by .5.
    d = np.ones(len(D)); d[0] = .5
    res = np.linalg.lstsq(D.T * d**2, g_true - ridge*w_true, rcond=None)[0]
    y = D @ w_true - res
    gain, offset = np.array([1.6, .75, 1.2, 1.1]), np.array([.2, -.1, .3, -.4])
    sweep_banks = np.array([0, 0, 0, 0, 1, 1, 1, 3, 3, 3])
    refs = np.array([-2., -1., 1., 2., -1., 0., 1., -1., 0., 1.])
    reads = gain[sweep_banks]*refs + offset[sweep_banks]
    reads[[2, 5]] += [25., 9.]
    # Bank 0 screens a spike; bank 1 uses prior gain and current offset;
    # bank 2 keeps its prior unchanged; the clean triple in bank 3 overrides its prior.
    prior = np.array([[1., 0.], [.75, .8], [1.2, .3], [1., 0.]])
    banks = np.array([0, 1, 2, 3, 0, 1, 2, 3])
    raw = gain[banks]*y + offset[banks]
    calibrated = calibrate_affine_banks(raw, banks, refs, reads, sweep_banks, prior=prior)
    np.testing.assert_allclose(calibrated, y, atol=2e-12)
    signal = 1e-3
    prior2 = prior.copy(); prior2[:, 1] *= signal
    y2 = calibrate_affine_banks(signal*raw[row_perm], banks[row_perm],
                               signal*refs, signal*reads, sweep_banks, prior=prior2)
    np.testing.assert_allclose(y2, signal*y[row_perm], atol=2e-14)

    w, cert = fit_box_simplex(D, calibrated, Z, cap=.6, budget=1., source_ridge=ridge, nuisance_ridge=1.)
    np.testing.assert_allclose(w, w_true, atol=2e-11)
    np.testing.assert_allclose(w.sum(), 1., atol=2e-12)
    np.testing.assert_allclose(terminal @ w, truth @ w_true, atol=2e-11)
    np.testing.assert_allclose(cert['nu_sum'], .1, atol=2e-11)
    np.testing.assert_allclose(cert['lam_lower'], [.2, 0., 0.], atol=2e-11)
    np.testing.assert_allclose(cert['lam_upper'], [0., 0., .3], atol=2e-11)
    objective = .5 * (np.linalg.norm(d*res)**2 + ridge*(w_true @ w_true))
    np.testing.assert_allclose(cert['primal_objective'], objective, atol=2e-12)
    np.testing.assert_allclose(cert['dual_lower_bound'], objective, atol=2e-12)
    w2, cert2 = fit_box_simplex(signal*D2, y2, Z[row_perm], cap=.6, budget=1.,
                                source_ridge=ridge*signal**2, nuisance_ridge=1.)
    np.testing.assert_allclose(w2, w, atol=2e-11)
    np.testing.assert_allclose(cert2['dual_lower_bound']/signal**2, objective, atol=2e-12)
    assert all(np.isfinite(a).all() for a in (D, terminal, D2, terminal2, calibrated, y2, w, w2))
    assert all(np.isfinite(value).all() for c in (cert, cert2) for value in c.values())


run_self_test()
"
}
